title: SAIF-VERSE Update v1.0.9 — Live GPS Google Coordinates & 10m Movement Engine
changelog:
🌸 What's New in v1.0.9:
• Exact Google-formatted Latitude & Longitude in Activity reports
• Automatic Community Dispatch whenever you move >= 10 meters
• Stationary 1-hour pulse: broadcasts exact location every hour even if unchanged
• Live GPS Card in Activity view with 1-tap coordinate copy and direct Google Maps link
• Complete offline queueing for GPS tracking (auto-pushes when internet reconnects)
• Enhanced background stability and minor bug fixes across all mobile devices
